other_conditions: Must be a student pursuing a full‑time MBA/MCA or equivalent two‑year degree or diploma from an eligible institute
Must hold a full‑time graduate degree in engineering or a BCA degree
Must have a strong aptitude for computer programming and data analytics
Must have a minimum 60% aggregate marks at graduate level or equivalent CGPA
A basic understanding of financial markets is desirable but not mandatory
benefits_summary: Interns receive a stipend of ₹25,000 (3 days/week) or ₹30,000 (4 days/week), along with paid leaves, accommodation for out‑station candidates, a completion certificate, and additional perks such as public holidays and lunch at the SEBI office.
